entities.name: Mijo Udovčić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mijo Udovčić was a Yugoslavian chess player, who became the first Croatian Grandmaster in 1962. Jointly with Borislav Ivkov, he won the Yugoslav championships in 1963.
